title: Add the customer's latest order for the home page
description: The home page shows a 'your last order' card. Adds GET /api/orders/latest with the signed-in customer's most recent order and its product. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: The test creates two orders back to back and relies on their `createdAt` differing, but it is stored to the millisecond, so both can get the same time and the route may return either order: the test is flaky. Set `createdAt` explicitly, as the products test does (and the route could add `id` as a tie-breaker).
